messages.completeGenerationBuildsWallsStreetsAndB: Complete generation builds walls, streets and buildings. Use the slider to inspect all thirteen stages. Stage 13 hides roads from the city centre to the outer wall and lanes dividing blocks, while keeping river bridges. Blocks, roads and walls remain editable in the finished map; choosing a tool reveals the grid. Reproduce the same city using its seed or shared link.
